column1: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree) — design class with insert(word), search(word) (exact match), and startsWith(prefix). Example: insert('apple'); search('apple')→True; search('app')→False; startsWith('app')→True; insert('app'); search('app')→True.
column2: PATTERN: Trie node = dict of char→child + is_end flag. | INSIGHT: Walk char by char; create children as needed; mark final node's is_end on insert. | STEPS: TrieNode: children={}, is_end=False. insert: walk, create missing children, mark is_end at the final node. search: walk; missing child → False; at end return final.is_end. startsWith: walk; missing child → False; at end True. | TIME/SPACE: O(L) per op / O(N·L). | PITFALL: search must check is_end; startsWith does NOT.

column1: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure — class supporting addWord(word) and search(pattern) where pattern can contain '.' (matches any single char). Example: add 'bad','dad','mad'; search('pad')→False; search('.ad')→True; search('b..')→True.
column2: PATTERN: Trie + DFS for wildcard search. | INSIGHT: '.' means recurse on all children; literal char means recurse on that child if it exists. | STEPS: addWord: standard trie insert. search: dfs(node,i): if i==len: return node.is_end. c=word[i]. If c=='.': for child in node.children.values(): if dfs(child,i+1): True; return False. Else: if c in children: dfs(children[c], i+1); else False. | TIME/SPACE: addWord O(L); search worst O(26^L) / O(N·L). | PITFALL: Wildcards near the start blow up; in practice it's OK.

column1: Word Search II — given m×n board of chars and a list of words, return all words that appear on the board (chars adjacent 4-directionally; each cell used at most once per word). Example: board with words=['oath','pea','eat','rain'] → ['oath','eat'].
column2: PATTERN: Trie + DFS backtracking on board. | INSIGHT: Build a trie of all words; DFS from each cell following only trie children; on hitting a node marked with a word, record it. Clear the marker to dedupe and prune. | STEPS: 1) Build trie; store the word string at the terminal node. 2) For each cell (r,c): dfs(r,c,node). 3) dfs: if out of bounds or visited or board[r][c] not in node.children: return. nxt=node.children[board[r][c]]; if nxt.word: ans.append(nxt.word); nxt.word=None. Mark visited (mutate cell to '#'); recurse 4-dir; restore. | TIME/SPACE: O(M·N·4^L) / O(N·L). | PITFALL: Setting nxt.word=None after a hit avoids duplicates and prunes future visits.
